subject.title: Feature: add gateway.controlUi.timezone for Control UI timestamp rendering

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `gateway.controlUi.timezone` config/bootstrap contract for Control UI timestamp rendering, and if so which value set should be supported?
rationale: The current issue is a feature/config request, and repository policy treats new public config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive rather than an autonomous bug-fix lane.

options.title: Accept A Narrow Config
options.body: Approve an additive Control UI timezone key with a small value set, explicit validation, docs, and compatibility-preserving default behavior.

options.title: Keep Browser-Local Only
options.body: Reject the new config surface and keep Control UI timestamp timezone behavior tied to the browser, with privacy-browser caveats handled in docs or user settings.

options.title: Defer For Broader Time Policy
options.body: Keep this issue as a product thread until maintainers choose a unified timezone model across Control UI, usage, logs, and agent defaults.

recommendation.title: Accept A Narrow Config
recommendation.body: Approve an additive Control UI timezone key with a small value set, explicit validation, docs, and compatibility-preserving default behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the exact Control UI timestamp/bootstrap path that a timezone contract must preserve.
